subject: Meridian Health: AWS co-sell handshake & joint account runbook
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@meridianhealth.com>, Tim Barker <tim.barker@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian Health — request: AWS co-sell handshake + mutual action plan

Hi Ava / Tim,

Thanks again for the intro (Tim) — excited about the opportunity to partner here. Meridian's team mentioned wanting a quick co-sell orientation so they can align procurement + technical stakeholders and decide on pilot scope.

High-level ask: can AWS provide a warm-intro call (AMER AP) next week so we can introduce Redwood, review a short mutual action plan (MAP), and confirm procurement timelines? Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 5m intros + goal alignment
- 10m Meridian pain areas & priority workflows
- 10m Redwood solution fit + deployment options (hosted vs private)
- 5m Co-sell ask: AWS support / incentives / marketplace listing cadence
- 5m Next steps / owners / dates

I attached a draft MAP and a starter SOW so we have something concrete to iterate on.

Proposed slots (PST): Mon 4/5 9:30-10:15, Tue 4/6 11:00-11:45, Wed 4/7 13:00-13:45. If none work, share a few times and we’ll flex.

Kimberly and Laura — I’m looping you for procurement alignment and listing requirements.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Meridian-MAP-v1.1.pdf (draft MAP), SOW-draft.docx (scope + budget stub)

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@meridianhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Barker <tim.barker@amazon.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian Health — request: AWS co-sell handshake + mutual action plan

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear agenda and the docs.

Tim, great to have you on this. We can do Tue 4/6 11:00-11:45 PST — that works for our clinical ops and cloud procurement lead.

A couple of asks on our side before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood’s Private deployment supports our on-prem HSM integration?
- Any outline of marketplace listing timing if we choose hosted first then move to dedicated?
- Procurement will want a short checklist of required security evidence ahead of the call (SOC2 attestation, data residency, logging).

I’ll send a calendar invite to lock the time. Looking forward to the intro.

Best,
Ava Collins
Director of Digital Strategy
Meridian Health Systems
ava.collins@meridianhealth.com

Thanks everyone for the quick call earlier — appreciated the clarity. As promised, attaching the updated MAP (v1.1 with owners) and a concise procurement checklist below to help procurement triage: 

Procurement checklist (summary):
- SOC 2 Type II report (AWS-hosted + Redwood-managed logs)
- Data residency statement (region: us-west-2)
- HSM/KMS integration options (on-prem HSM via Private deployment + KMS for hosted)
- SLAs & support model (Dedicated options + escalation path)
- Contracting lead / procurement POC and expected PO timeline

Next steps from Redwood:
- Share final MAP with owners (attached) — action: Kimberly to own procurement items and get legal redline window
- Provide SOW draft for pilot (attached) — Laura to own scoping discussion
- Coordinate AWS incentives checklist (Tim) — ask Tim for any co-sell credits or listing acceleration steps

Kimberly: can you confirm typical legal turnaround time for a pilot SOW (high level) so we can set expectations with Meridian?

Laura: I'll schedule a scoping working session for Thu 4/8 10am PST — let me know if that conflicts with your calendar.

Thanks — Sergio

Attachments: Meridian-MAP-v1.1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Meridian follow-ups & owner tracker (quick)

Team — quick internal sync so we’re aligned ahead of Thurs scoping: 

Summary of commitments from Tue call:
- Redwood: provide MAP w/ owners, procurement checklist, SOW draft (Done)
- Kimberly: lead procurement engagement and chase SOC2 evidence w/ AWS where needed
- Laura: run scoping workshop and produce pilot success criteria
- Jonas: catalog listing requirements if Meridian wants a marketplace path after pilot

Kimberly — please reply with an ETA for initial procurement packet (SOC2 + data residency note). If we can get a short packet by EOD Wed 4/7, we should be able to keep the PO timeline tight.

Also, Jonas — if you can start a short doc of listing artifacts (pricing SKU, usage metering expectations, support-level mapping) that would be helpful for the scoping workshop.

Thanks,
Sergio
